thesis: U.S.-based manufacturer of zinc-based (Znyth) battery energy storage systems for long-duration, utility-scale applications. Non-flammable aqueous chemistry — now independently fire-tested with no thermal runaway and ISO 14001 certified — offers real safety and siting advantages over lithium-ion. TTM revenue exploded ~726% to ~$160.7M and preliminary Q2 2026 signals record quarterly revenue and backlog as manufacturing capacity doubles. A ~$263M rights offering (with Hudson Bay and Cerberus), a $75M direct offering, the new Frontier Power USA (FPUSA) project-finance platform, a Golden Dome selection, and a $305.3M DOE loan guarantee have strengthened funding and credibility — but at the cost of heavy dilution. The stock trades near 52-week lows and the entire thesis hinges on reaching positive gross margin, targeted around H2 2026.

financials.cash: Bolstered by ~$263M rights offering + $75M direct offering

drivers: Positive gross margin achieved around H2 2026, validating unit economics at scale
Record Q2 2026 revenue and backlog confirmed; doubled annual production capacity ramps cleanly
FPUSA (~$375M targeted equity, KKR Capital Markets engaged) converts its ~1.8 GWh selected/closed pipeline into funded orders
$305.3M DOE loan guarantee drawn to fund manufacturing expansion
Golden Dome for America and defense/grid demand plus ISO 14001 / no-thermal-runaway safety edge drive share gains vs lithium-ion

base_case.assumptions: Revenue keeps scaling on record backlog but gross margin turns positive only around H2 2026 and stays thin; DOE loan draws proceed with some delay; FPUSA converts part of its ~1.8 GWh pipeline; continued but manageable dilution. Market pays a growth multiple on a credible-but-not-yet-proven path to profitability.

risks: Gross margin inflection slips beyond H2 2026; cash burn forces further dilutive raises
Convertible-note debt and warrant overhang keep pressuring the share count and price
Manufacturing ramp stumbles; capacity-reservation orders (e.g. Redbird) fail to convert
Lithium-ion cost declines erode the value proposition for long-duration storage
DOE loan draw milestones or FPUSA financing closings are delayed

catalysts.event: Q2 2026 earnings — preliminary results already signal record quarterly revenue and backlog; watch margin trajectory and updated guidance
Gross-margin inflection — the key thesis trigger; management targets a turn to positive gross margin
DOE $305.3M loan draw milestones — funds manufacturing expansion without equity dilution
FPUSA project closings / capacity conversions — converting the ~1.8 GWh selected/closed pipeline (incl. Redbird 2 GWh reservation) into funded purchase orders
Golden Dome for America deliveries — first 'mission-ready power' shipments validate defense/grid credibility

key_risks: Continued dilution from the rights offering, $75M registered direct offering, and warrants
Still-negative gross margins during the manufacturing scale-up
Heavy convertible-note debt load with associated dilution/refinancing risk
Execution risk on the manufacturing ramp and on converting FPUSA/backlog capacity into revenue
